Record Class PlayerSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.dtos.snapshots.PlayerSnapshot
Record Components:
nickname - The player's nickname.
color - The color associated with the player.
prestigeTokens - The current amount of prestige tokens the player has.
foodTokens - The current amount of food tokens the player has.
shamanStars - The number of shaman stars the player has collected.
topDrawNum - The number of draws the player is allowed from the top row.
bottomDrawNum - The number of draws the player is allowed from the bottom row.
characterDeck - A map categorizing the character cards owned by the player.
buildingDeck - The list of building cards owned by the player.
charactersSets - A map tracking the number of character sets completed.
inventorPairs - A map tracking the pairs of inventor cards collected.
public record PlayerSnapshot(String nickname, Color color, int prestigeTokens, int foodTokens, int shamanStars, int topDrawNum, int bottomDrawNum, Map<CharacterType, List<CharacterCard>> characterDeck, List<BuildingCard> buildingDeck, Map<CharacterType, Integer> charactersSets, Map<InventionIcon, Integer> inventorPairs) extends Record
Represents a static snapshot of a player's state, including resources and cards.
